caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box, centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background with a thin rectangular border framing the composition. The box is rendered in two primary colors: a dark, almost black shade for the central panels and a warm yellow-brown for the edges and corners. The front and top of the box have visible golden-yellow hardware, including a central lock and small circular rivet-like details along the edges. A thin, dark brown handle arches over the top of the box, attached at each end to small metallic fixtures. The box is slightly three-dimensional, viewed from the front and above, and there is a small emblem or decorative element at the center of the front panel. The artist's signature is at the bottom right corner of the outlined rectangle.
title: Sewing Box
